From 1996 to 1998, he served as Platoon Leader of the Reconnaissance Platoon of the Single Guard Battalion. In 1998, he was selected to take an Infantry Officers’ Course at the Finnish Reserve Officers’ School. In 2016, he was rotated to the Estonian Defence League, where he served for a year in the Headquarters as G3/Branch Chief Operations, and two years as Commander of the Territorial Defence Region Northeast in Eastern Estonia.
